text: スーパー　おにいさんショー　はーじまーるよー！
note: The host calls himself おにいさん ("big brother"), the usual title for the young male presenter of a Japanese children's TV show. The English game renamed him the Poké Dude.
claim: Young male presenters of Japanese children's TV programmes, such as NHK's Okaasan to Issho, are called おにいさん (oniisan).

check.quote: うたのおにいさん（歌のお兄さん）は、日本の公共放送であるNHKの子供向け番組『うたのえほん』...『おかあさんといっしょ』...の男性の役名。
